room_or_space: NORTH ELEVATION - exterior north face of the whole building; no room is named on the sheet

proportions.notable_proportion: Strongly horizontal composition: the drawn elevation is many times longer than it is tall, with low-pitched hipped roofs whose eaves project far beyond the walls and with wall bands much longer than they are high. No dimensions are written, so no ratio can be stated.

layout.organisation: Three stepped masses read left to right: a long two-storey wing at the left with a low plinth, a band of small ground-level windows and a ribbon of tall upper windows under a deep hipped roof; a taller central block carrying a third storey under its own hipped roof, flanked by two tall rectangular chimney/stack masses; and a two-storey right-hand section whose upper storey is a continuous window band under a very long cantilevered roof, ending in a low walled terrace at the far right. A separate low wall with a post stands at the far left.
layout.axes: No axis of symmetry. Dominant axes are horizontal: ground line, plinth/water-table line, sill courses, roof fascias and ridge lines all run as continuous horizontals; the only verticals of weight are the two chimney/stack masses and the piers between windows.
layout.entry_sequence: No entrance door is legible on this face. The only ground-level features are the low walled terrace at the right and the low wall and post at the left.
layout.circulation: Not shown; the sheet is an exterior elevation with no internal circulation indicated.
